question.html:
A magnet is dropped through two identical copper loops. One is at the top of a tall vacuum chamber; the other is at the bottom where the magnet has a higher speed. Which loop produces the greater peak induced emf?

  1. Top loop, because flux change begins there
  2. Bottom loop, because flux changes faster
  3. Both loops produce equal emf
  4. Neither loop induces any emf in vacuum
